title: ajuga crenata
intro: Ajuga crenata, commonly known as Chinese bugle, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This perennial plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ajuga crenata include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. Studies suggest that the plant may also have neuroprotective effects due to its antioxidant properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of health benefits.
